_comment: Ceilings for how far the C++ engine's OWN frame (FrameScene built from the scene's project document by premation-scene, D2w) may differ from the TS WebGPU frame. A LIST OF DEBTS, meant to be removed. video-decoded-frame: the FrameScene is structurally identical and the native backend draws the TS-uploaded texel bit-identically; the difference is the decode itself — E1's ffmpeg YUV->RGB conversion (chroma siting / matrix rounding) vs Chromium's WebCodecs/VideoFrame decode of the same H.264 frame. Fixing it belongs to E1's conversion parity, not the scene builder. Frames not ported yet are not listed (reported as not-ported, never failed).
